entries.title: Career Semi-Quant Terminal
points: Browser-based quantitative research terminal covering 70+ semiconductor companies across the US, Korea, Japan, Taiwan and Europe, with prices, fundamentals and ~3,000 past earnings reports refreshed automatically twice a day.

Implemented institutional models from scratch in JavaScript: a Barra-style multi-factor risk model, QMJ quality scores, hidden-Markov regime detection, Engle-Granger pairs screening with false-discovery-rate control, and relative rotation graphs.

Portfolio construction and risk: exact efficient frontier, risk parity, hierarchical risk parity and Black-Litterman; component VaR, historical crisis replays, regime-switching drawdown forecasts, volatility targeting and Brinson attribution.

Research tooling: walk-forward backtests with transaction costs, earnings event studies and information-coefficient analysis of the quant score; statistics validated against statsmodels, with unit and browser tests gating every release in CI.
